answer.reason: Both sell AI-enabled cloud software to small businesses. Thryv sells CRM, marketing and lead tools plus done-for-you marketing services to local service businesses. Intuit sells financial software (QuickBooks accounting, TurboTax) and Mailchimp marketing software. Only Mailchimp overlaps with Thryv's marketing software. Intuit's core is accounting, tax and credit, and it also serves consumers. Overlap is partial on both products and customers, so it is adjacent, not direct.
